what_it_is.prose: This card groups the commercial microelectronics vendors whose parts underpin modern avionics: Intel and AMD (via Xilinx) for processors and FPGAs, Microchip (via Microsemi) for radiation-tolerant/secure FPGAs, and Texas Instruments and STMicroelectronics for microcontrollers and analogue/RF devices. These components sit inside mission computers, radar and electronic-warfare signal processors and flight systems as generic commercial-off-the-shelf silicon, sourced through the systems integrators rather than under any discrete, publicly documented India defence contract. Recorded as an honest Tier C generic-component card.
